run_curate_argoverse: run the script to curate depth-labeled pixel data from Argoverse2 sensor logs into JSONL
run_lidar_to_camera_projection: run the main block to project LiDAR point clouds onto camera images with motion compensation
run_depth_label_extraction: run the script to extract depth labels by sampling 100 pixels per frame from LiDAR sweeps
review_get_immediate_subfolders: review the get_immediate_subfolders function that lists immediate subdirectories in a given folder path
run_intrinsic_normalization: run the script to normalize camera intrinsics to fx=1000 and resize images accordingly
